metadata.keyBasis: Read from the /key(...) directive in the source notation.
metadata.bpmBasis: Read from the BPM directive in the source notation.
metadata.sectionBasis: Each sung line was checked against the exact song's public labelled lyrics or chord/lyric form; section labels were rebuilt from that source rather than inferred from the previous JSON.
metadata.transcriptionRule: Hyphens are folded into note duration. Same-pitch continuation notes for one lyric are merged; different-pitch melismas are retained with an empty lyric.
metadata.controlNotationRule: Key-change markers are removed from lyric text and applied cumulatively to the marked note and all following notes, matching the source parser. Structural labels such as intro/interlude are not treated as sung lyrics.

lineBreakResearch.provider: NetEase Cloud Music public synchronized lyrics
